final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, SUM(f.transaction_amount) AS amt FROM Financial_Transactions f JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = f.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(amt) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.st AS st, s1.amt AS amt, s1.amt * 1.0 / NULLIF(s2.tot, 0) AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS av FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.st AS st, s3.amt AS amt, s3.ratio AS ratio, s3.ratio - s4.av AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.ratio > s4.av) SELECT SUM(amt), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM s5
